svg.aria-label: Ten dental-webinar clips: meaning-error points and word error rate side by side
svg.text: Dental webinars: ten clips, 30 minutes of standard spoken Finnish
Against the University of Helsinki's transcripts, which leave out fillers (“niinku”, “tota”); so word error rate
favours models that drop them too. The judges ignore fillers and count only meaning. Lower is better in both.
Whisper-style models win on word error rate; Gemini 3.5 Flash and ElevenLabs make the fewest meaning errors. Our model is
built for dialects and is not the pick here. The transcripts were not checked by a listener (see the README).
